requirements: Recapture official detail leaves for The Pizza Company, Starlight Cinema, Gong Cha and Katinat. Review newer R4 evidence before repeating captures. Preserve every original candidate ID.

Use rendered detail-body text or official first-party API fields instead of requiring a generic offer-card container. Bind each claim to exact quoted spans and byte offsets, DOM ranges or JSON pointers in immutable captured evidence.
Capture requested URL, final URL, redirects, HTTP status, actual UTC timestamp, raw response, rendered DOM, source hashes and metadata hashes. Never manufacture timestamps, HTML or terms.

Reject failed fetches, soft 404, menu/header/footer/metadata-only claims and unrelated offers. Require title/benefit, amount where claimed, current validity or recurrence, restrictions and explicit applicability to Da Nang for the same offer. Brand presence alone does not prove applicability.

Keep canonical registry trust anchoring and independent reproducibility. Test unrelated-price substitution, expired dates, locality mixing, excluded-node claims and altered raw evidence. A new detail-text evaluator requires CEO review before accepting VERIFIED results.

Create stable discovery IDs B19_TCH_DISCOVERY_001 and B19_POPEYES_DISCOVERY_001 for the existing The Coffee House and Popeyes captures. Mark DISCOVERY_PENDING until an actual detail offer is identified; then assign a unique offer ID and preserve discovery lineage. Do not count these placeholders toward the original eight-of-ten target.
Produce day-by-day timeline eligibility with exact recurrence/date and exceptions. Never infer a weekly offer from a monthly promotion or ordinary menu price.
Minimum eight is a target, not permission to relax evidence. Report shortfall and exact missing claims. Leave unproven records HELD. No publication or staging merge before CEO acceptance.
